about:
International Plastics, operating as interplas®, is headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina. The company was founded in 1964 by J.R. McClure, who borrowed $500 from his mother to start producing polyethylene bags for the region's textile mills. His wife, Frances, joined him in building the business one customer at a time. The company remains family-owned, with the second generation now helping set strategic direction.

The firm manufactures, imports, and wholesale supplies flexible packaging and plastic bags, stocking more than 9,000 items across 250-plus categories. Its product range includes poly bags, reclosable ziplock bags, trash bags and liners, poly tubing and film, stretch and shrink film, and shipping supplies. Custom printing, custom sizing, and in-house artwork services (with two hours of free art time per order) are offered through four purchasing paths: stock packaging with same-day shipping, bulk pallet and truckload orders, custom printed packaging, and just-in-time inventory programs. All orders run through an ISO 9001 certified quality system, and the company operates from ten stocking locations nationwide.

Interplas serves food service, healthcare, retail and apparel, security, moving and storage, warehouse and industrial, and electronics and ESD markets. Its customer base includes businesses, resellers, and distributors who buy at wholesale, factory-direct pricing.

The company traces its differentiation to its founding principle that "doing right by people is good business." It emphasizes a people-first culture, audited processes, same-day shipping on stock orders, a lowest-price guarantee, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee.
